lore.syncretism: Ereškigal appears within the Mesopotamian tradition and has influenced later retellings, artistic depictions, and scholarly study. The Unicode restoration preserves the name's distinctive orthography for contemporary use.
lore.culturalLegacy: Ereškigal continues to appear in scholarship, art, and popular reception as a significant figure of the Mesopotamian tradition. Restoring the name in Unicode returns the original marks that ASCII removes.
lore.extendedMeditation: Ereškigal embodies queen of the underworld in the Mesopotamian imagination. The name's restoration is not merely cosmetic: it recovers the stress, length, and script that make the figure recognizable in the source tradition.
lore.archaeology: Ereškigal is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Mesopotamian tradition.
